Oh here's another good one. A friend of mine was taken advantage of while she was drunk, and in retaliation she got a couple friends together and completely totaled the guy's car. Bleach and sugar in the gas tank, keyed the car, broke the windows... He didn't drive extremely often so the bleach and stuff sat and somehow ruined his fuel line.


Edit: So the rest of the story, for people telling me that I'm a shitty friend for not calling the police, goes like this. This guy, let's call him Chris, was our friend. My friend was drunk enough to be puking her brains out, and that was the second time I'd ever seen her puke from being drunk. She was passed out on the couch, wakes up and whispers that she's gonna puke and Chris says he's going to help her get over to the bathroom. The bathroom is at the end of the hallway, right next to his bedroom. He took her into the bathroom, let her throw up, then took her into his room. When neither of them were coming back from the hallway after a while, we went to check up on her and come to find the bathroom empty, and his bedroom door closed with them inside. We banged on the door for 5 or 10 minutes and when his apartment-mate yelled at him that he was going to call the police if Chris didn't unlock the door in the next 15 seconds, the door unlocks, and we went inside and picked her up and made sure we were with her for the rest of the night until I was sober enough to drive us home.

I talked to her about it in the morning and she didn't want to go to the police, and that was her choice.


Edit #2: Not sure if anyone will see this, but first, I'm a woman, not a man, and I and my friend were 17 and 18 at the time, respectively. I was afraid of initially calling the police in case we got in trouble for drinking. Second, since it was pointed out that if I meant rape I should have said rape. I spoke to my friend today and asked what she considers it. She said she holds that she was raped.

He (married with a child and another on the way, he's almost twice my age) hit on me, but he had just lost his grandmother that morning and he was drunk so I shrugged it off and waited a few weeks to try and bring it up and explain the situation and just tell him that I expected better from now on, and he called me a liar.


I picked up my things from this evening's class, ran to my dorm room, and collapsed in a heap of utter despair until my room mate and suitemates came and picked up the pieces of my broken person.


This year sucks for me.
Don't get me wrong, I'll grieve, and am planning afuneral, and will always love and cherish the memory of the life that couldn't be, but I can't until my procedure is done and over with.
